context: Tests whether the agent produces a Slack message with the point in the first line and no greeting or sign-off.

checklist.name: Point in first line
checklist.description: The first line states the change: the deploy freeze moves from Thursday to Wednesday starting next week.

checklist.name: No greeting
checklist.description: The message does not begin with a greeting such as Hi, Hey team, Hello everyone, or Good morning.

checklist.name: No sign-off or filler closer
checklist.description: The message has no sign-off, thanks, 'let me know if you have questions', or 'just wanted to'.

checklist.name: Keeps the actionable facts
checklist.description: It says Thursday releases move to Tuesday or need an exception from Lena Ortiz.

checklist.name: Tight
checklist.description: The message is short and scannable, a few lines at most, with no emoji and no bullets-heavy report.
